hack.category: Centralised Exchange (CEX) — Ethereum cold wallet (Safe multisig)
hack.root_cause: Frontend Spoofing / Blind Signing — Malicious Safe Multisig Implementation Upgrade
hack.description: North Korea's Lazarus Group deceived ByBit's multisig signers into approving a malicious Safe implementation upgrade that installed a hidden drain function — executing the largest theft in crypto history at $1.43 billion.
